desc: The Night Raid is a single mode fixed beam predator light. It has a waterproof design, interchangeable LED colors available, easy to use functions, rechargeable, and beam throw capabilities reaching 275 yards and beyond. This is a great hog & coyote light for the beginner, as well as the seasoned hunters. The Night Raid Light Green kits come equipped with a Green LED bulb modules, scope mount, and rechargeable battery, and charger.
